method.games: Every head-to-head matchup since 2011, read from Yahoo's weekly matchups for each season plus this season's box scores. The weekly game against the league median is not a rivalry and is left out, and so are consolation-bracket games. Playoff and championship games are in, and flagged.
method.manager: Records follow the manager, not the team name, so every rename counts as the same franchise. Teams whose manager is unknown are left out.
method.heat: Heat = (meetings + 3 per playoff meeting + 2 per one-score game + 2 per series lead change) x (0.35 + 0.65 x balance), where balance is 1 when the series is even and 0 when one side has won every game. A one-score game is decided by fewer than 8 points. A rivalry needs 8 meetings to be ranked.
